findings.text: follow-on: the discovery_roots entry value is not pinned by any test. tests/config/test_facility_config_compliance.py validates schema, enum membership and required fields but asserts nothing about the specific path list, so a later edit that reverted this entry to the stale /analysis/src/ofmcauto, or to any other path, would pass the gate green. This is inherent to a host-path config value (no test can assert a remote directory exists without the hop), so it is recorded rather than fixed; a cheap partial pin would assert the entry is absent from the list, which is the failure this change repairs.
